_comment: Tamework shared access, Part 1 (Tamework only). Tamework's HEAD, Rune_Husbandry's tamed livestock, and RuneCore because Rune_Professions keeps the Husbandry levels that Rune_Husbandry's feed and harvest interactions require. Rune_Professions comes in as its newest release (no network settings store, no guild group). The two bots (ShareOwner, ShareFriend) are started by the test itself (t.require), not listed here, so env.py's memory estimate (4.5 GB per bot) does not refuse the environment on a PC that has the room for the server alone.
